value: Removing an entry (CLI removeEntry, MCP reverie_remove) cascades ALIASES that point at the key or its children — not confirmation flags. Since #244 (2026-11-25) a removal leaves flags listed and warns: a flag gates its name in every project, so dropping it could ungate another project's entry. Clear one with `rvr confirm remove`. Since #267, `rm ns.k` also deletes the hidden `ns.k.sub` of an entry+namespace pair. A namespace rm whose delete fails exits 1 (IO) and skips the alias cascade (#277). Don't write defensive alias cleanup after a remove.
